ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Ideology steps
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Reusable Pickle steps that build an ideoligion from chosen memes and precepts, give a colonist another ideoligion, build a prison cell with a restrained prisoner, set the prisoner's interaction mode and read the modes the game offers, and that read back a message and the job a colonist is doing. Developer tooling; no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See IdeologySteps/README.md at the repository root.
They sit under a text of their own ("Nelim's Pickle Tools: ...") so they can never be ambiguous with Pickle's steps.
Developer test companion for RimWorld 1.6. Requires Pickle; the steps need the Ideology DLC, and a scenario that uses them tags itself @requires:Ludeon.RimWorld.Ideology. No gameplay content or scenarios included. Enable only for test suites that use these steps.
